class.name: image_transport/camera_compress_pub
class.description: Publishes sensor_msgs/CompressedImage on <base>/camera_compress. 8-bit color and mono8 are JPEG. 16UC1 and mono16 are PNG.

class.name: image_transport/camera_compress_sub
class.description: Decodes a camera_compress topic back into sensor_msgs/Image.

class.name: image_transport/vaapi_compress_pub
class.description: Publishes sensor_msgs/CompressedImage on <base>/vaapi_compress. Color is VA-API JPEG, with libjpeg-turbo fallback. 16UC1 and mono16 are PNG.

class.name: image_transport/depth_rvl_compress_pub
class.description: Publishes sensor_msgs/CompressedImage on <base>/depth_rvl_compress. 16UC1 and mono16 are lossless RVL. Other encodings are skipped.

class.name: image_transport/depth_rvl_compress_sub
class.description: Decodes a depth_rvl_compress topic back into sensor_msgs/Image.

class.name: image_transport/depth_png_compress_pub
class.description: Publishes sensor_msgs/CompressedImage on <base>/depth_png_compress. 16UC1 and mono16 are lossless PNG at level 1 with RLE. Other encodings are skipped.

class.name: image_transport/depth_png_compress_sub
class.description: Decodes a depth_png_compress topic back into sensor_msgs/Image.

class.name: image_transport/vaapi_compress_sub
class.description: Decodes a vaapi_compress topic back into sensor_msgs/Image.
